maintainerNote: This profile has been **the toughest challenge in the series**. It is also the profile on which I put **Kimi K2** to the test, the model that is hardest to keep running autonomously over extended periods.

In the early weeks Kimi **burned through the entire weekly budget in a couple of days**. To keep the team from sitting idle waiting for the reset, I spread the load across multiple subscriptions and, above all, progressively refined the pacing and spending monitoring. Today **the budget is metered out rigorously** and the daily cap is no longer exceeded; in the meantime, however, the pool of listings genuinely relevant to this profile has started to shrink.

One final milestone is still missing before I can call it a full success: that, **on a single subscription, the team works autonomously day after day for at least one consecutive month**, without interruptions. Once that point is reached, it will become the reference case of the series.
